follow-up time: 1 year before and after educational intervention
exposure: Educational intervention on opportunistic complete bilateral salpingectomy (CBS) at cesarean delivery (CD)
cohort: OBGYN physicians who perform CD at a single institution
finding: An educational intervention was associated with a significant increase in the performance of complete bilateral salpingectomy at the time of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: An educational initiative on opportunistic complete bilateral salpingectomy (CBS) at the time of cesarean delivery (CD) was associated with a significant increase in performance of CBS at CD.
